query:
SELECT s.id, s.userId, s.teamId, s.teamName, s.shareToken, COUNT(sp.id) as playerCount
FROM squads s
LEFT JOIN squadPlayers sp ON sp.squadId = s.id
GROUP BY s.id, s.userId, s.teamId, s.teamName, s.shareToken;
